title: Arbitrage opportunity using different prices in the same block
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The current implementation of the `PythAdapter` contract allows using different prices for the same token in the same block. This can be exploited by a malicious user to make a profit with zero risk.  There are different ways of performing an operation without updating the price feed of a certain token:  - Omit the target token in the array sent to `updatePriceFeeds`. - Submit an outdated price for the target token (`updatePriceFeeds` does not revert in this case). - Swap through `swapExactTokensForTokensWithoutPriceFeedU
